issue: Registration succeeds but account/session is not persisted; login status not maintained across page reload
actual: Registered new account "QATester99" (qatester99@example.com), got "Account created! Welcome to ThreadHive!" toast and was logged in. After reloading http://localhost:7019/, the header reverted to showing "Login"/"Register" links (logged out). Attempting to log back in with the same registered email/password returned "Invalid credentials. Try: tech@example.com", proving the account was not actually persisted server-side and the session was not maintained.
evidence: Toast "Invalid credentials. Try: tech@example.com" after using registered credentials on /login post-reload.

Edited Bio and Interests fields via Edit Profile form, clicked Save, got "Profile updated!" toast, and page immediately displayed new bio "QA Tester bio: I love testing forum apps and finding bugs." and interest tags "QA Testing", "Automation", "Hiking".

Selected category "Creative Corner", entered title "QA Test Thread for Automated Checklist" and body content, clicked Create Thread. Got "Thread created successfully!" toast, navigated to new thread page /thread/thread-1788358126289 showing correct category badge (Creative Corner), correct title as heading, and correct body content.

issue: No rich text editing support; markdown-style formatting is not rendered
actual: The thread content textbox on /new-thread is a plain textarea with no formatting toolbar (no bold/link/list buttons). Entered content "This is a **bold** test with a [link](https://example.com) and a list: - item one - item two" and after posting, the thread page displays this text completely literally (asterisks and markdown link syntax shown as-is), with no bold styling, no clickable link, and no bulleted list rendering.
evidence: Rendered paragraph on thread page: "This is a **bold** test with a [link](https://example.com) and a list: - item one - item two" (plain text, unrendered).

Typed reply text, clicked Post Reply, got "Reply posted!" toast. Reply list updated instantly to show the new reply text under "Replies (1)" heading, and thread's reply count updated from 0 to 1 replies without needing a page reload.
Clicked upvote button on the thread post: count updated from 0 to 1 instantly. Clicked upvote button on the reply: count updated from 0 to 1 instantly. Both updates reflected without page reload.

issue: No edit functionality exists for posts/replies
actual: On the thread page for a thread and reply authored by the currently logged-in user (TechExplorer), inspected all buttons/links (including via DOM query for aria-label/title containing "edit", "delete", "menu", "more") and found none. There is no UI affordance to edit a published thread or reply, so an "Edited" mark or last-edit-time feature cannot be tested/exists.
evidence: DOM query for edit/delete/menu controls on thread page returned empty array.

Clicking the poster's username link (e.g. "TechExplorer") on a thread/reply navigates to /profile/user-1, which displays the poster's public profile: avatar, join date, reputation, bio, interest tags, and their thread history.

issue: Profile page shows only thread history, not reply history
actual: Visited own profile page (/profile/user-1) after posting a new thread and a reply. The page only shows a "Threads by TechExplorer (3)" section listing threads created by the user; there is no section, tab, or list showing the replies the user has posted (e.g. the reply "This is a QA test reply to verify real-time display." made earlier is not shown anywhere on the profile).
evidence: Profile page sections observed: header (bio/interests) and "Threads by TechExplorer (3)" only — no "Replies" section present.

Searched "Pomodoro" (body-only match, not in title): correctly returned only "Share your favorite productivity tips!" thread whose body contains "Pomodoro technique". Page header updated to "Showing results for ...".

Clicked "Technology" category link, navigated to /category/tech, page heading shows "Technology" and only displays threads belonging to that category ("Building a mechanical keyboard from scratch" and "What programming language should I learn in 2024?"), no threads from other categories present.

Profile page /profile/user-1 correctly restored the previously edited bio ("QA Tester bio: I love testing forum apps and finding bugs."), interest tags (QA Testing, Automation, Hiking), and the full thread history including the thread created earlier in this session with its updated vote count (1) and reply count (1) intact.
